QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default off (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`, `:2185`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the threading macros "default off" in the header but never states that the shipped config leaves them undefined. Its note that "the index was built with both THREADING flags set" muddies whether a default build defines neither.
